name: seq4-acceptance
about: LIVE acceptance of an installed app release (brief candidate7 L1-L5). WRITE-ONLY here: it joins a live network by a single-use invite and runs a member node. Everything runs in <out>/rig; teardown stops the app and the member node it started.

params.release_archive: the app release archive, e.g. Ducktape-<rev>-linux-x86_64.tar.zst
params.release_key_file: file with the app release key (64 hex); a secret, compared to keys/release.pub
params.version: the version the installed launcher must report, e.g. 0.1.0+e0fbcb88
params.invite_file: file with the single-use invitation line (0600); a secret, never written anywhere
params.network: the network's workspace dir name the waiting step shows, e.g. dognet#b5b6ea90
params.node_archive: the member node release archive, e.g. ducktape-<rev>-linux-x86_64.tar.zst
params.node_release_key_file: file with the release key the member node's launcher pins (64 hex); a secret

steps.say: L1 the release archive is the one named
L1 make the unpack dirs
L1 unpack the release
L1 install with the release's own launcher
L1 the installed launcher reports the release's version
L1 state.json is idle
L1 state.json pins the release's sequence
L1 keys/release.pub is byte-equal to the key file
L2 boot the installed launcher
L2 the launch window offers Join with invitation
press Join with invitation
steps.expect: the invitation screen shows an Invitation field and a Join network button

steps.say: put the invitation into the Invitation field
steps.expect: the Invitation field holds a hidden value and the Join network button is enabled

steps.say: press Join network
steps.expect: the app is setting up the network (a step such as Setting up your network or Waiting for your node) and shows no refusal or error sentence

steps.say: L2 the waiting step shows the node command block
L2 unpack the member node release
L2 install the member node as the waiting step says
L2 run the member node as the waiting step says
L2 the ready screen offers Open Ducktape (this step's ms = node start to ready)
press Open Ducktape
steps.expect: a wallet step shows (Protect your wallet with Password and Confirm password fields) or the workspace opens; no error sentence

steps.say: put the wallet password into the Password field
steps.expect: the Password field holds a hidden value

steps.say: put the wallet password into the Confirm password field
steps.expect: the Confirm password field holds a hidden value and Create wallet is enabled

steps.say: press Create wallet
steps.expect: the recovery phrase step shows (Write down your recovery phrase) with its words hidden

steps.say: remember the recovery phrase words the screen shows (the door reveals them to this rig only; held in memory, never written or sent)
press I wrote it down
steps.expect: the confirm step asks for the requested recovery words

steps.say: type the words the confirm step asks for (its prompt names their numbers) into the answer field
press Confirm recovery phrase
steps.expect: the account step shows (Your account); no error sentence

steps.say: the account step shows: Your account
continue without an account
steps.expect: the workspace console opens with its rail of tabs

steps.say: L2 the console is open (this step's ms = open to first tab)
open the Home tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Home tab is selected and its view shows; no error sentence and no 'not registered' sentence is visible

steps.say: open the Chat tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Chat tab is selected and its view shows; no error sentence and no 'not registered' sentence is visible

steps.say: open the Files tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Files tab is selected and its view shows; no error sentence and no 'not registered' sentence is visible

steps.say: open the Pages tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Pages tab is selected and its view shows; no error sentence and no 'not registered' sentence is visible

steps.say: open the Forge tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Forge tab is selected and its view shows; no error sentence and no 'not registered' sentence is visible

steps.say: open the Inbox tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Inbox tab is selected and its view shows; no error sentence and no 'not registered' sentence is visible

steps.say: open the Governance tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Governance tab is selected and its view shows; no error sentence and no 'not registered' sentence is visible

steps.say: open the Members tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Members tab is selected and its view shows; no error sentence and no 'not registered' sentence is visible

steps.say: open the Agents tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Agents tab is selected and its view shows; no error sentence and no 'not registered' sentence is visible

steps.say: open the Node tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Node tab is selected and its view shows; no error sentence and no 'not registered' sentence is visible

steps.say: open the Explorer tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Explorer tab is selected and its view shows; no error sentence and no 'not registered' sentence is visible

steps.say: open the Settings tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Settings tab is selected and its view shows; no error sentence and no 'not registered' sentence is visible

steps.say: open the General section of Settings
steps.expect: the General settings pane shows, with a Check now button

steps.say: press Check now
steps.expect: the update check answers (up to date, or the channel's newest release); no error sentence and no older release is offered or staged

steps.say: L5 quit the app
L5 reopen the installed launcher
L5 the reopened app lands on the workspace
quit the app
